correctness.rationale: For two-state row Markov generators, X_h and Y_h are stochastic with determinant θ=e^{-(α+β)h} and equal trace 1+θ. Direct off-diagonal polynomials of M_{h,1} have nonnegative factors and the diagonal entries follow from trace; Cayley–Hamilton yields (4Y_h^p-X_h^p)/3=M_{h,1}^p for every p. For the two-edge equal-rate three-state pure-birth witness, upper triangularity yields exactly (M_{h,p})_{01}=p q^{4p-2}(1-q²)(8q-q²-1)/3; row sums and a bound on (M_{h,p})_{02} complete the sharp iff q≥4-√15. Independent symbolic reconstruction verified the 2-state identity for p=1..4 and 3-state formulas for p=1,2,3,5,8. The all-p statement follows from the structural identities, not extrapolation from tests.
